name: After Dark
blurb: Where the night stops pretending. Intense, but all invitation.

cards.text: Describe the moment tonight you wanted to kiss them but didn't. What stopped you?
Undress them slowly — their pace, their call. Every item comes off with eye contact.
cards.speak: While you do, say what you love about the person underneath, not just the skin.
cards.soften: Remove one item of their choosing, slowly.

cards.text: Mutual gaze, two minutes, no words. Hands on each other's hearts. The timer is the only voice.
cards.soften: One minute, eyes closed, foreheads touching.

cards.text: Trace their lips with one finger. They keep their eyes closed. Describe out loud what you want to do next — you don't have to do it yet.
cards.soften: Trace their hand instead. Same rule.

cards.text: What's something you've been curious about with me but never brought up? Curiosity is the only price of admission.
Sixty seconds: describe each other's body using only words you'd want said about your soul.
Kiss down their neck, unhurried. The rule: wherever you pause, you must say one true thing before moving on.
cards.soften: Three slow kisses, three true things.

cards.text: Trade answers: what does desire feel like in your body — and what makes it louder for you tonight?
Tell them about the last time a simple look or gesture from them made your whole body light up with want.
Share one quiet desire you've been carrying that you would love to explore together soon.
Describe a moment from the past month when their presence alone made ordinary time feel electric.
What is one way they draw you in that still catches you off guard every time?
Recall a shared night that still lives in your body as pure heat and closeness.
Name one thing about the way they move or speak that turns the air warmer for you.
Invite them into a slow, lingering kiss and keep it soft and full of promise.
cards.speak: I still get lost in you like this.
cards.soften: Offer a warm forehead-to-forehead moment and a soft smile instead.

cards.text: Pull them close for a quiet embrace and stay there long enough for the rest of the room to fade.
cards.speak: Right here with you is exactly where I want to be.
cards.soften: Give a gentle side hug and rest your head near theirs for a few breaths.

cards.text: Trace a slow path along their arm or back while looking into their eyes.
cards.speak: Every time I touch you I remember how lucky I am.
cards.soften: Simply hold their hand and give a warm squeeze while smiling.

cards.text: Lean in and offer a series of soft kisses along their jaw or cheek, unhurried.
cards.speak: I could stay this close to you for hours.
cards.soften: Place one gentle kiss on their cheek and linger nearby.

cards.text: Guide their hand to rest against your chest so they can feel your heartbeat for a moment.
cards.speak: This is what you do to me.
cards.soften: Place your hand over theirs and hold it against your heart briefly.

cards.text: Whisper a private invitation for later while pressing a slow kiss to their temple.
cards.speak: I already know how I want tonight to end with you.
cards.soften: Smile and quietly say you are looking forward to more time alone together.

cards.text: Wrap your arms around them from behind and sway together for a few breaths.
cards.speak: You feel so good against me.
cards.soften: Stand close and rest a hand on their shoulder while sharing a quiet moment.

cards.text: Offer to undress them slowly by one piece of clothing, pausing to appreciate each reveal.
cards.speak: I love discovering you all over again.
cards.soften: Help them remove just one outer layer and leave a soft kiss on the newly bare skin.

cards.text: Sit them down and give a slow, attentive foot or hand massage for a full minute.
cards.soften: Simply hold their hand or foot and give a few warm strokes.

cards.text: Invite them to close their eyes while you place three soft kisses anywhere you choose.
cards.soften: Ask them to close their eyes and give one gentle kiss on the hand or cheek.

cards.text: Sit facing each other, keep continuous soft contact with hands or arms, and hold steady eye contact for a full minute without speaking.
cards.soften: Hold hands and share soft eye contact for twenty seconds, smiling if it feels easier.

cards.text: Each of you names three specific things you want more of from the other — small gestures, moments, or ways of being close — then choose one to begin tonight.
cards.soften: Each share one simple thing you would enjoy more of from the other this week.

cards.text: Take turns leading a slow, close dance in place for one song, staying pressed close the whole time.
cards.soften: Sway together gently for half a song while holding each other.

cards.text: Talk about the kind of night that leaves you both feeling completely claimed by each other.
Share the little signals that tell you the other is already thinking about later.
Describe the atmosphere you both love most when the lights are low and the rest of the world has disappeared.
